changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla ai_jobs: trabajos asíncronos de IA (los escribe ai/; la API solo lee); public_id es el job_id del contrato. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría ai_jobs_audit y el trigger ai_jobs_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Asynchronous AI jobs. Written by the ai service (smartmentor_ai); the API only reads it. public_id is the job_id of the ai contract

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: job_type
column.remarks: Job type (for example syllabus.structure); open list defined by the ai contract

column.name: status
column.remarks: Job status: queued, running, succeeded or failed

column.name: idempotency_key
column.remarks: Idempotency key of the job, unique

column.name: input_sha256
column.remarks: SHA-256 of the canonical input, to detect key reuse with another body

column.name: input
column.remarks: Job input

column.name: result
column.remarks: Job result validated against the contract

column.name: error_code
column.remarks: Error code when the job failed

column.name: error_message
column.remarks: Error message when the job failed

column.name: attempts
column.remarks: Executions of the job

column.name: requested_by
column.remarks: Caller that requested the job (service or user identifier)

column.name: course_id
column.remarks: Course related to the job, for cost filters

column.name: topic_id
column.remarks: Topic related to the job

column.name: enrollment_id
column.remarks: Enrollment related to the job (foreign key added with enrollments)

column.name: started_at
column.remarks: Moment the job started running

column.name: finished_at
column.remarks: Moment the job finished

column.name: locked_until
column.remarks: Lease of the worker that runs the job

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ai_jobs ADD CONSTRAINT ai_jobs_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed'))
ALTER TABLE ai_jobs ADD CONSTRAINT ai_jobs_attempts_ck CHECK (attempts >= 0)
CREATE TRIGGER ai_jobs_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON ai_jobs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in ai_jobs

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ai_jobs_audit ADD CONSTRAINT ai_jobs_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER ai_jobs_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON ai_jobs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS ai_jobs_audit_trg ON ai_jobs
